Class MK

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.MK
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.fabricmc.api.ModInitializer
public class MK extends Object implements net.fabricmc.api.ModInitializer
Mod entry point for MenuKit and the process-wide facade for HUD panels, notifications, and the recipe-book query.

The consumer surface by task:

  • Panels and elements: Panel, PanelElement, Button, TextLabel
  • Panels on vanilla container screens: ScreenPanelAdapter, SlotGroupPanelAdapter
  • HUD panels: MKHudPanel
  • Standalone screens: MKScreen
  • Layout: Row, Column
Created slots, custom menus, and per-slot state are in MenuKit: Containers (MKCContainerPanel, MKCMenu, MKSlotState).

Supported static methods on this class: registerHud(MKHudPanelDef), registerNotification(MKHudNotification), notify(String, String), isRecipeBookOpen(), setRecipeBookOpen(boolean), init(). onInitialize() is the Fabric entry point and is internal.

    • init

      public static void init()
      Common-side initialization for the MenuKit artifact. Post-§0042 split: M1 state-machinery init + verification init moved to MKC (the `menukit-containers` artifact). MenuKit has no common-side state to register (HUD registration is lazy via consumer registerHud(MKHudPanelDef) calls). Retained as a no-op log so consumer mods that explicitly call MK.init() for ordering continue to compile and produce a visible init trace.

    • initClient

      public static void initClient()
      Client-side initialization for the MenuKit artifact. Invoked from MKClient.onInitializeClient(). Post-§0042 split: M1 client-state init + verification client init moved to MKCClient. Retained as a no-op log for symmetry with init().

    • renderHud

      public static void renderHud(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor graphics, net.minecraft.client.DeltaTracker deltaTracker)
      Renders all registered HUD panels. Called at RETURN of Gui.render() by MKGuiMixin. Evaluates visibility conditions, resolves anchor positions, and delegates to each panel's element tree.

      Uses vanilla's GuiGraphicsExtractor and coordinate system directly — working WITH vanilla, not against it.

    • notify

      public static void notify(String key, String text)
      Triggers a notification by key. The notification slides in, displays for its configured duration, then fades out.
      Parameters:
      key - notification key (must match a MKHudNotification.builder(String) registration)
      text - text to display, or null for icon-only

    • isRecipeBookOpen

      public static boolean isRecipeBookOpen()
      Returns whether the recipe book is currently visible on the active screen. Safe to call at any time; returns false when there is no active screen or the active screen has no recipe book.

      Delegates to the client-side implementation; this is the public, consumer-facing entry point.

    • setRecipeBookOpen

      public static void setRecipeBookOpen(boolean open)
      Sets the recipe book's visibility on the active screen. No-op when the active screen has no recipe book or the requested state already matches.

      Delegates to the client-side implementation; this is the public, consumer-facing entry point.

      Parameters:
      open - true to show the recipe book, false to hide it
